methodology.scope: single-thread in-process consensus and SQLite :memory: application
methodology.completion: all three replicas applied; sqlite mode applies one local database
methodology.workload: unique integer primary key, integer value, optional fixed ASCII text
methodology.batch: proposals admitted before draining; sqlite baseline uses one transaction per batch
methodology.latency: nearest-rank batch completion microseconds, never divided by batch size
methodology.verification: exact row count, every key/value/text, and applied prefix on every replica
methodology.resources: per-child wait4 CPU and peak RSS include startup, warmup and verification
methodology.throughput: timed operations only; setup, warmup and verification excluded
methodology.summary: median, min, max and median absolute deviation; no outlier removal
methodology.order: seeded shuffle of all cases and variants in each repetition
